page.overview:
Who is Wood Remains?

Wood Remains are a character versions of the card "Wood Remains", appearing in the Yu-Gi-Oh! GX anime.

Wood Remains appeared in the Duel Monsters Spirit World, presumably as part of the oppressed Duel Monster Spirits in that dimension, since they are low-Level and marching in front of a group of Stealth Birds.
